mood: Something wet has walked inland: cold teal, bone, weed-green, and one warm rope-orange that does not belong to it.
inspiration: Tidal mud at dusk, corroded bronze, drowned linen, the pale of things kept underwater.
anchor_reason: Teal sits opposite bronze on the wheel, so anything the Sea touches reads as foreign to the Palace world at a glance, and it holds contrast on both surfaces without going neon.
rule_bent: The accent partner is a warm rope-orange rather than a cool harmony, so that the Sea palette keeps one human colour to steal. Originality warning against tumulus (0.044) lifted by Jason on 2026-09-27: these are sprite palettes for a game, a different category from app UI themes, and tide and ash are intentional siblings.

rejected.why: The first Jointed sample came out five colours of grey; the Sea needs a warm foil.
Reads as science fiction, not brine.

seed: Mood words and the slice art pass Sea colour map (bone #d8d2c4, teal #2f5f5a, rope #c0662e).
